prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final game environment concept board for a compact 小卖铺 kiosk in a Chinese prison factory campus, not production assets yet.
Input image 1: reference for exact location, nearby architecture, floor material, camera and hand-painted game art style. The red rectangle marks a temporary repair-room building to completely redesign. It is south of the second machine workshop, east of the canteen, west of the small garden. The editor UI, red marking and yellow editor handles are not part of the art.
Primary request: Show an attractive, compact half-open neighborhood-style kiosk in this footprint, with an enclosed back and side storage zone and a broad sales window facing SOUTH toward the pedestrian path. Customers stand outside the counter; seller stands inside. Replace every temporary bench, metal parts chest and drum and generic prison stone wall in the marked footprint. Give the kiosk its own architecture, not a remodeled workshop.
Composition: polished landscape concept board, large main view occupying about 70% of the image on the left, game camera nearly overhead orthographic with subtle visible front faces, axes parallel to image edges just like input, not a diagonal isometric view. Zoom in on kiosk in its map setting but still show part of the canteen at left, workshop north, garden at right, and walking apron south. Two smaller panels stacked on right: enlarged sales-window detail, and roof-on exterior appearance from the same camera. Restrained off-white board margins. Clear short Chinese headings: "园区小卖铺", "售货窗口", "屋顶外观". No dense explanatory text.
Main design: low practical kiosk with soft ivory plaster rear wall, muted old sage green metal trim, honey-brown timber service counter with simple recessed panels. Wide fully open sales hatch, side wood display shelves, shelves against back wall with orderly small grouped goods. A plain aged ivory sign above the hatch reads exactly "小卖铺". Narrow muted sage green corrugated metal lean-to canopy with crisp slim edging, slightly overhangs sales counter. Main view uses a roof cutaway so the service zone and goods are clear, secondary roof panel shows complete simple roof with matching fascia. Moderately aged but cared-for surfaces, restrained wear without rust overload or clutter. Small practical staff entry at side/back, cashier register and a paper price list on counter, one understated light beneath canopy. Goods are simple period-appropriate bottles, biscuit tins, instant noodle packets and daily essentials like soap, towels and toothpaste, no real brands. Seller in plain utilitarian work clothes behind counter and one orange-clothed inmate customer outside, matching existing game scale. Warm, approachable everyday service point within this industrial campus.
Materials and lighting: same finely painted 2.5D game sprites, matte textures, controlled dark outlines, muted earthly colors, warm timber contrast with sage metal. Neutral daytime overhead lighting and short consistent soft shadows; no cinematic bloom.
Constraints: kiosk fits wholly within marked original footprint and does not intrude into garden or road. Maintain existing green-gray small square paved road outside kiosk, canteen, machine workshop and garden layout. Existing walking connections around building remain open. Show a clean and legible entrance/service frontage, no enormous unused interior, no surrounding solid prison walls blocking window. Display sales window as open trading counter, no customer walk-through room required.
Avoid: editor interface; red rectangle; modern commercial branding; neon; large supermarket; modern glass showroom; ornate roof; stripes; over-saturated green; excessive dirt/cracks; a new road material; panoramic map with tiny unreadable kiosk; photography; fully diagonal isometric camera.
